verdict.rationale: Pylon has a public API and an official MCP server. However, the only access-control evidence is that MCP clients authenticate via OAuth and inherit the user's full visible data scope. Nothing documents issuing API keys or tokens with restricted scopes, read-only limits, or per-agent least-privilege permissions, so the OAuth delegation is an adjacent feature, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
